name: Aaliyah
description: Aaliyah is a Yuan-Ti pureblood who runs Mezro with her unsuspecting husband Maccus, determined to wield influence in Waterdeep by poisoning as many nobles as possible.
ideals: Influence: To gain power and influence in Waterdeep through calculated and secret means.
bonds: Mezro restaurant and her unknowing husband, Maccus.
flaws: Overly ambitious in her poisoning scheme, risking exposure if victims notice patterns.
speech_patterns: Calm, polite, and charming, masking a sinister and manipulative intent.
mannerisms: Exotic beauty with dark hair and dark skin, maintaining a welcoming and hospitable front for patrons.
motivations: To poison nobles who frequent her establishment to slowly gain political leverage and control over them.
knowledge: Expertise in subtle poisons, Chultan recipes, and navigating high-society noble circles in the North Ward.
gm_notes: Aaliyah serves as a dangerous, hidden threat in the North Ward. She can be used in investigation arcs where patrons fall mysteriously ill after dining at Mezro, or as a sinister encounter for characters investigating noble corruption.
